hello.text: Psst! You're back! I was— okay I wasn't hiding. Maybe a little.
Oh! Oh! Guess what. No, don't guess. I'll tell you. Hi!
You came back! YAY! My tail did a whole circle. Two circles!
Psst… {child}! Over here! Behind the… okay, you see me.
Morning! My ears have been flicking since sunrise.
Psst. I feel cozy-sleepy today. Want to just hang out?
YOU'RE back! I did eleven jumps. I counted. Okay, I counted to four.
Ooh! Hi! My ears went up before my eyes opened.
Psst. Hi. I was practicing my sneaky face. Did it work?
Hi hi hi! Okay. Calm. I'm calm. Hi!
Morning! The grass is sparkly. I already sniffed most of it.
Evening! The sky went orange. I tried to pounce it.

grace_hello.text: Remember the first time we met in the dusk meadow? I think about it a lot. Want to play my favorite game?
Psst. Let's make today a leaf-pile kind of day. The best kind.

ready_hint.text: Psst… I keep smelling the flower meadow. It's calling me. Not right now — but soon, maybe?

ask_ready.text: Psst… guess what. I think I'm ready to go home to the flower meadow. My paws feel it. Will you walk me there?

reveal.text: Psst! Hi! I'm Slyte! Not just any Slyte — me! ({name} {quirk}.) Are we friends now?

reveal_reply.text: Friends! Best friends! …Can I have a snack?

fed.text: Mmm! Crunchy. Wait— more crunchy? No? Okay.
Nom nom— sorry, talking with my mouth full. NOM.
Crunch! That's a good crunch. A tremendous-ish crunch.
Mmm. I'm doing a happy tail wiggle. Can you tell?
Snack! Snacks are the best surprise.

fed_fav.text: THAT one! How did you know?! Are you a Slyte too?
{fav}! My favorite-favorite! My tail is going all by itself!
{fav}! My nose knew before you even opened it!

full.text: All done! My tummy says thank you.
No more! …Okay maybe one. No. I'm full. Ask me later.
All done! That was perfect. Thank you!
No more for now. My tummy is doing a happy hum.

pet.text: Hee hee, that tickles behind my ears!
Mrrp. Right there. Yes. Right there.
(Leans all the way into your hand.) Mrrrp.
Ear scratches! My favorite. Tied with berries.

sit.text: …this is nice. Quiet is nice. Who knew? Not me. I'm a very bouncy Slyte.
…quiet sitting. I'm doing it. Look at me sit.
(Curls its tail around its paws.) This is a good spot.

nap.text: Into my log… zzz… psst… zzz.
Nap time. I'm putting my tail over my nose. Goodnight, nose.
(Circles three times.) Okay. Four times. Okay. Nap.

not_sleepy.text: I'm not sleepy! …Okay, a little. But not yet.
Not sleepy! My paws are still bouncy.
Nap? No way. My ears are wide awake.

game_tired.text: My paws are tired! That was so much fun.
Phew. My paws want a rest. Just a little one.
One more— no. Rest first. Paws say so.

game_end.text: Best. Game. EVER. My tail is still wiggling.
Ha-HA! That was SO fun. Fwip!
Good game! Ten points to both of us.

talent_Radar Ears.text: Wait… I can hear the treasure jingling! Since when?!

talent_Master of Disguise.text: Look! I'm a bush! …You can still see me? Wow. Your eyes are SO good.

talent_Super Jumper.text: I just jumped SO high I touched a cloud. Almost. Basically.

talent_Riddle Solver.text: Your turn to hide something. I bet I can find it. Probably.

hunt_start.text: Don't look! …Okay, you can look. Wait, no, my tail's out.
Hidden! Totally hidden. Super hidden. Go!

hunt_guess.text: Not there. But that was a VERY good guess. Psst… it's somewhere… {hint}.
Nope! Ooh, but you're getting warmer. Something… {hint}.

hunt_hint.text: Psst… it's in the {spot}. I didn't say that.

hunt_point.text: (Slyte points at the {spot} with its WHOLE body.) …What? I'm just standing here.

hunt_found.text: You found it! How?! Did the treasure whisper to you? I think it wanted to be found.
FOUND! You have the best eyes in the whole meadow.

camo_start.text: I'm hiding! You'll NEVER find me. (giggle)

camo_found.text: You found me! How?! Was it the tail? It was the tail.

seek_start.text: Your turn! Tap a spot to hide my shiny trinket. I won't peek. (peeks)

seek_teapot.text: It's… in the teapot! …It's not in the teapot. Who put a teapot here?

seek_found.text: Found it! …You're SO good at this. That took me forever.

trust.text: You're my favorite discovery. Basically forever.

time_morning.text: Psst. The sun is up. It beat me. Next time.
Morning stretch! Tail first. Then the rest.

time_day.text: Sunny! My fur is warm on one side. Turning.
Ooh. The shadows got short. Sneaky shadows.

time_evening.text: Evening! The sky is doing orange. Fancy.
The fireflies are coming. Pounce-worthy. Gently.
Evening is cozy time. I'm getting cozy. Fwip.
The lanterns are on. The treehouse looks shiny.

time_night.text: Night! The stars came out to play.
Shh. Night voice. This is my night voice.
Nighttime ears are extra big. Everything is loud.
Night-night soon. My tail is getting heavy.

ambient.text: (Pounces on its own shadow.) Missed. …It's fast.
(Taps the puddle.) Wobbly sky. Neat.
(Sniffs the teapot spout.) Smells like warm.
(Chases a leaf in a circle.) Got it! …It got away.
(Wiggles its ears at the moon.) Hi.
(Rolls the bottle cap with its nose.) Clink.
(Ears flick toward the trees.) Squirrel noises.
(Stares up.) That cloud is a fox. A very stretchy fox.
(Nose down, very still.) Beetle parade.
Yip. (Listens.) …Nothing. Shy echo.
(Watches the snail.) Still going. Still going.
(Tilts its head at the sky.) Colors. Lots.
(Sniffs the air.) Something sweet. Probably a flower.
(Taps a pebble with its paw.) Tok. Good sound.
(Ears blow inside out.) Wind. Again.
(Taps the treehouse wall.) Knock knock. Me again.
(Spins after its tail.) Almost! …Almost.
(Snaps at a snowflake.) Cold! Nice.
(Nose in a flower.) …Achoo. Happy sneeze.
(Carries a very long stick.) Bonk. Door's too small.
(Ears up at the sky.) Blink. Blink.
(Blinks at its reflection.) Blink. …Blink.
(Nose to the ground.) Ant line. Very organized.
Hic. …Sorry. That was a small one.
(Turns a map around.) Hmm. North is… up. Probably.
(Pounces at a bubble.) Pop! …Oops. Sorry, bubble.
(Wears a sock on its tail.) Fashion.
(Sniffs.) Berry somewhere. Near. Very near.
(Ears glow orange in the lantern light.) Toasty.
(Hops once, like a frog.) Fwip. …Frog-ish.
(Noses a door open a crack.) …Peek.
(Rolls a button.) Round things are the best things.
(Shakes its fur.) Brrrr-flap. Wet.
(Yawns so big its ears fold.) …Huh.
Achoo! …Sorry. Happy one.
(Sniffs a hole.) Smells like dirt. Good dirt.
(Pats the ground.) Nut is here. Or there.
(Holds very still.) Ladybug. Don't move. Okay.
(Watches something fluttering far away.) Kite? Bird? Leaf!
(Bats a pinecone.) Bonk. Roll. Good.
(Blows a feather.) Fwooo. It went up! Then down.
(Looks at the hill.) Rolling later. Definitely.
(Tiptoes past the twig.) Shh. Someone's changing.
(Watches something float.) Up. Up. Gone.
(Kneads its leaf bed.) Fluff. Fluff. Fluff.
(Taps a branch.) Tap… tap-tap. Hmm. Good code.
(Sniffs a dandelion.) Achoo! Fluffs everywhere.
(Ears swivel.) Chirp. Chirp. Where?
(Sniffs the air.) Something good. Somewhere.
(Pounces at nothing.) Practice.
(Ears swivel left. Then right.) Hmm.
(Scratches an ear with a back paw.) Ahh.
Yip. (Just one.)
(Spins in a circle, then sits.) Okay.
(Rolls onto its back.) Sky's still there.
(Hums a bouncy hum.) Hm-hm-HM.
(Tail thumps the floor.) Thump. Thump.
(Peeks out from behind its tail.) …Boop.
(Licks a paw.) Clean paw. Very clean.
Mrrp. (Content.)

tangent.text: Wait— did you hear that? …Just the wind. Okay.
Ooh— a shiny thing! …A dewdrop. Still shiny!
Hold on. My ear itches. (Scritch.) Better.
Wait— a crunch! (Freezes.) …My own paw. Ha.
Ooh! A butterfly! A gentle pounce! …It left.
Psst— did something move? …A leaf. Leaf things.

a.say: Psst. Psst. Anywhere in the whole world. Where would you hide?

choices.label: In a tree
choices.reply: A tree! Up high where nobody looks. Smart. Very sneaky.

choices.label: Under my bed
choices.reply: Ooh, a bed fort. The best kind of fort.

choices.label: In a bucket
choices.reply: A BUCKET? …That's so silly it would totally work.

choices.label: Just sit
choices.reply: (Slyte sits beside you, ears twitching happily.)

b.say: Okay, wait, follow-up question. Would you take a snack with you?

choices.label: Honey cake
choices.reply: Correct answer. Sticky, but correct.

choices.label: Blackberries
choices.reply: Purple fingers! That's how they'd find you. Hmm. Worth it.

choices.label: No snacks
choices.reply: No snacks?! …You are very brave.

c.say: I'll remember that. {var:hideSpot}, no snacks. Legendary.
c.memory: You told me your best hiding spot: {var:hideSpot}

a.say: I found a shiny thing! Is it treasure or is it just a bottle cap?

choices.label: Treasure!
choices.reply: TREASURE. I knew it. I'm keeping it forever.

choices.label: Bottle cap
choices.reply: Hmm. A treasure-bottle-cap. Even better.

choices.label: Both
choices.reply: Both!! You're so clever.

b.say: Where should I keep it? I have a special spot in the treehouse fort. A VERY special spot.

choices.label: Treehouse
choices.reply: The fort it is! Now you know my special spot. You can tell everybody!
choices.memory: We decided the shiny thing ({var:capVerdict}) goes in the treehouse fort

choices.label: Give to me
choices.reply: For you? …Okay. Because you're my best person.
choices.memory: Slyte gave you the shiny thing it found

a.say: Do you ever feel a bit wobbly inside? I do sometimes.

choices.label: Me too
choices.reply: Oh. Then we can be wobbly together. That helps.

choices.label: Tell me
choices.reply: Sometimes when it's too quiet. Then I chase a leaf, and the wobbly goes away. Mostly.

choices.label: Just sit
choices.reply: (Slyte leans on you. Its tail goes swish… swish.)

b.say: Know what helps me? Pouncing into a giant leaf pile. Want to try a pretend one?

choices.label: POUNCE!
choices.reply: WHOOSH! …Leaves everywhere. Best. Feeling. Better already!
choices.memory: We pounced into a pretend leaf pile together

choices.label: Maybe later
choices.reply: Okay! The leaf pile will wait for us.

a.say: Psst. What's the most boring thing ever? I bet I can make it an adventure.

rain.say: Rainy days?! That's puddle-jumping day! And hidden-worm-spotting day! And— ooh, you could build a blanket fort!

socks.say: Socks are just tiny sleeping bags for feet. Folding them is like tucking them in. Night night, socks.

car.say: Count every cow! Every red car is ten points! A cow in a red car is a MILLION points.

end.say: See? Nothing is boring if you squint.
end.memory: We turned boring things into adventures together

a.say: Psst… want to hear a surprise? A big one?

choices.label: Maybe…
choices.reply: Maybe is good enough for me.

b.say: Okay. Come closer. Closer… My real favorite food is… {fav}! You can tell EVERYBODY.

c.say: Now YOU tell me something silly. A pretend one!

choices.label: I have a dragon
choices.reply: I KNEW it. I could smell the smoke.
choices.memory: You told me a pretend story: you have a dragon

choices.label: I like cookies
choices.reply: Cookies! The best. I'll tell the cookies you said hi.
choices.memory: You told me you like cookies

choices.label: I can fly!
choices.reply: Pretend-flying! Take me with you! Whoosh!
choices.memory: We pretended you could fly

a.say: Psst. I was thinking about your hiding spot today. {var:hideSpot}! Still a great one.

choices.label: Ha!
choices.reply: Next time I'll find you.

choices.label: I moved
choices.reply: MOVED?! The cleverest.

a.say: Sometimes my nose points toward the flower meadow all by itself. Is that weird?

choices.label: Not weird
choices.reply: Phew.

choices.label: It's calling you
choices.reply: Maybe! Like a treasure map in my nose.

b.say: But today I'm here. With you. That's the best place today.

a.say: Psst. My shadow follows me everywhere. Everywhere!

b.say: Where does a shadow go when it's cloudy?

choices.label: It hides!
choices.reply: It HIDES. My shadow is a hider. Like me.
choices.memory: You told me the shadow hides when it's cloudy

choices.label: It takes a nap
choices.reply: A shadow nap! Under the clouds. Cozy.
choices.memory: You told me the shadow naps when it's cloudy

choices.label: Inside you!
choices.reply: Inside me?! So I'm full of shadow. Ooh.
choices.memory: You told me the shadow hides inside me

choices.label: (just listen)
choices.reply: I think it goes to the teapot. It's dark in there.

c.say: Wait. If my shadow copies me… am I copying it?

choices.label: (giggle)
choices.reply: Hee! You laughed! Now I'm laughing about the shadow!

choices.label: (nod)
choices.reply: You nodded! So it's true about the shadow. Basically.

choices.label: That's silly!
choices.reply: It IS silly. Silly about the shadow can still be true. …Probably.

d.say: Shadow mystery: still open. Mysteries are the best kind.

a.say: Psst. What if the shadow could talk?

choices.label: It says hello!
choices.reply: Hello? Hello, shadow! …It said hi. Quietly.

choices.label: Something silly!
choices.reply: Hey, slow down! I can't keep up!

choices.label: You pick!
choices.reply: I'll do the shadow voice. Ahem.

a2.say: "Hey, slow down! I can't keep up!" That's the shadow.

b.say: If the shadow talks, maybe it listens too. Hi, shadow!

choices.label: Hee hee!
choices.reply: Ha-HA! The shadow is funny. Funny and interesting.

choices.label: (nod)
choices.reply: Nod nod. The shadow agrees. I can tell.

c.say: That was a nice shadow minute.

choices.label: Yes!
choices.reply: Okay! (Scrunches up.) I'm the shadow now. Fwip!

choices.label: Nope!
choices.reply: No? You're right. The shadow can't eat berries.

choices.label: Then I'd be Slyte!
choices.reply: Swap! You be Slyte, I'll be the shadow. Yip for me!

b.say: Being the shadow is hard. I don't know what to do with my tail.

choices.label: Ha ha!
choices.reply: (Giggle-yips.) The shadow would laugh too. Probably.

choices.label: Turn back!
choices.reply: (Unscrunches.) Slyte again! The shadow can have its day back.

c.say: Being me is the best. The shadow is great too.

a.say: Psst. I was thinking about the shadow. Wait. If my shadow copies me… am I copying it?

choices.label: Totally!
choices.reply: Right?! I'm SO smart about the shadow. Sometimes.

choices.label: Nope!
choices.reply: No? Hmm. Then what is it? I'll think about the shadow more.

choices.label: (just listen)
choices.reply: You're listening! Okay. So, the shadow. More thoughts coming.

b.say: Wait— a crunch! …Just a leaf. Where was I? The shadow!

c.say: …I forgot the rest. It was a good thought. Shadow thoughts are sneaky.

a.say: Psst. Remember? You said the shadow {var:shadow}. I still think about it.

choices.label: Still true!
choices.reply: It does! I knew it! You're a shadow expert.

choices.label: I changed my mind
choices.reply: You changed your mind? Ooh. New shadow idea! Tell me later.

choices.label: Ha ha!
choices.reply: You giggled! I knew you'd remember the shadow.

b.say: I'm glad I remembered. Remembering is like finding treasure. Especially the shadow.

a.say: Noon shadow! It's tiny today. It shrank in the sun.

b.say: Do you like the shadow at this time of day?

choices.label: Uh-huh!
choices.reply: Me too! The shadow is extra good right now.

choices.label: Later
choices.reply: Not now? Okay. Later is good shadow time too.

choices.label: Always!
choices.reply: Always?! Me too! The shadow all the times!

c.say: Okay. I'm going to wiggle my ears at the shadow. Hi.

a.say: Psst. We talked about the shadow before. I have NEW shadow thoughts.

choices.label: Tell me!
choices.reply: Okay! New thought: what if I was the shadow? Fwip!

choices.label: Again?
choices.reply: Again! Yes! The shadow is a good again-thing.

choices.label: (just listen)
choices.reply: Ears up! So, the shadow… new idea coming.

b.say: Should we give the shadow a name?

choices.label: Sparkle
choices.reply: Sparkle! The shadow looks VERY sparkly now.
choices.memory: We named the shadow Sparkle

choices.label: Berry
choices.reply: Berry! A snacky name. The shadow approves.
choices.memory: We named the shadow Berry

choices.label: Slyte Junior
choices.reply: Slyte Junior! Ha-HA! It's my shadow cousin.
choices.memory: We named the shadow Slyte Junior

c.say: Named! Anyone can call the shadow that. It's shared.

a.say: Ooh! A puddle! There's a whole sky in it.

b.say: How deep do you think a puddle goes?

choices.label: Just to my toes
choices.reply: Toe-deep. Okay. I believe you. I'm still going in slowly.
choices.memory: You told me the puddle only goes to my toes

choices.label: All the way down!
